description: This file defines the MaintenanceModuleController class within the OrangeHRM maintenance plugin. The controller extends an abstract module controller and includes a method to handle maintenance-related actions, specifically redirecting to a 'purgeEmployee' maintenance process.

classes.name: MaintenanceModuleController
classes.description: Controller class handling maintenance module actions, extending the abstract module controller.

methods.name: handle
methods.description: Handles the request to perform maintenance actions by redirecting to the 'purgeEmployee' page.
